description: This file contains the declarations and definitions for an H264 Annex-B video stream parser, including data structures for NAL units, SPS, PPS, slice headers, SEI messages, and the parser class with methods for parsing and handling H264 stream data.

classes.name: media::H264Parser
classes.description: A class for parsing Annex-B formatted H264 video streams, extracting NAL units, SPS, PPS, slice headers, SEI messages, and managing stream state.

methods.name: AdvanceToNextNALU
methods.description: Advances the stream to the next NALU and returns its information.

methods.name: ParseSPS
methods.description: Parses a Sequence Parameter Set (SPS) from the current NALU.

methods.name: ParsePPS
methods.description: Parses a Picture Parameter Set (PPS) from the current NALU.

methods.name: ParseSliceHeader
methods.description: Parses a slice header from the current NALU.

methods.name: ParseSEI
methods.description: Parses an SEI message from the current NALU.
